mapper.select: SELECT 'PI' kind,p.id,p.created_at FROM bike_pi p JOIN bike_pi_series s ON s.current_pi_id=p.id WHERE p.id!=#{paidPiId} AND p.status IN ('DRAFT','CONFIRMED') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bike_pi_item item WHERE item.pi_id=p.id AND item.product_model_id IN #{modelId}) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bike_pi_payment pay JOIN bike_pi origin ON origin.id=pay.pi_id WHERE origin.series_id=p.series_id AND pay.status='CONFIRMED') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bike_pi_order_link link JOIN bike_sales_order o ON o.id=link.order_id JOIN bike_sales_order_item item ON item.order_id=o.id LEFT JOIN bike_order_reservation r ON r.order_id=o.id WHERE link.series_id=p.series_id AND (item.shipped_qty>0 OR r.hold_mode IN ('PAID','CREDIT') OR r.scope_type='MODEL_LEGACY' OR o.status NOT IN ('DRAFT','PENDING','CONFIRMED'))) UNION ALL SELECT 'ORDER',o.id,o.created_at FROM bike_sales_order o JOIN bike_order_reservation r ON r.order_id=o.id JOIN bike_sales_order_item item ON item.order_id=o.id WHERE r.scope_type='SKU' AND r.hold_mode='TIMED' AND r.expires_at>NOW(3) AND o.status IN ('DRAFT','PENDING','CONFIRMED') AND item.shipped_qty=0 AND r.model_id IN #{modelId} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bike_pi_order_link link WHERE link.order_id=o.id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bike_pi p WHERE p.source_order_id=o.id) UNION ALL SELECT 'LOCK',l.id,l.created_at FROM bike_inventory_lock l WHERE l.scope_type='SKU' AND l.status IN ('LOCKED','PARTIAL_CONVERTED') AND l.expire_time>NOW(3) AND l.lock_qty>l.released_qty+l.converted_qty AND l.product_model_id IN #{modelId} ORDER BY created_at,id,kind
SELECT draft.id FROM bike_pi draft JOIN bike_pi current_pi ON current_pi.series_id=draft.series_id WHERE current_pi.id=#{piId} AND draft.id!=current_pi.id AND draft.status='DRAFT' ORDER BY draft.id
mapper.update: UPDATE bike_sales_order SET status='CANCELLED',remark=LEFT(CONCAT(#{reason},'；原备注：',COALESCE(remark,'')),500) WHERE id=#{orderId} AND status IN ('DRAFT','PENDING','CONFIRMED')
UPDATE bike_pi SET status='CANCELLED',release_status='BLOCKED',remark=LEFT(CONCAT(#{reason},'；原备注：',COALESCE(remark,'')),500) WHERE id=#{piId} AND status IN ('DRAFT','CONFIRMED')

UPDATE bike_inventory_lock SET status='RELEASED',released_qty=lock_qty-converted_qty,released_at=NOW(3), remark=LEFT(CONCAT(#{reason},'；原备注：',COALESCE(remark,'')),500) WHERE id=#{lockId} AND status IN ('LOCKED','PARTIAL_CONVERTED')
